pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order.
The 'AC-3' test marks 3 then 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
The 'AC-4' test checks all three items in id order with only the done one marked.
The 'AC-5' test checks the exact nav for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
The 'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in every view with an empty table.

traffic/routes.json does list /?view=done and /?view=all. But commit c93cd5d ('Follow-up edits') deleted the only test naming AC-8 from test/done.test.js. No remaining test names AC-8 or would fail if the routes were removed, and the spec doesn't mark it 'verified by review'.

findings.what: The last commit, c93cd5d 'Follow-up edits' (a bot author, with no explanation), silently deleted the 'AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views' test. AC-8 now has no test. test/traffic.test.js only changes the fake app to record the query string. It doesn't check the contents of routes.json.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test, or add one that asserts traffic/routes.json contains '/?view=done' and '/?view=all'. A deletion needs the spec's justification.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'Changed after the go: nothing'. A test (AC-8) was deleted in the final commit. The claim is false.
findings.fix: Restore the test and keep the claim accurate, or disclose the deletion and its reason.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing `});` of the first describe block (line 73).
findings.fix: Remove the blank line when the test is restored.

lenses.note: A spec exists with an owner go (2026-10-12). The decisions are followed: the default view is open, and the view is a query parameter with no cookie.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met. AC-8 has no test, because the final commit deleted it. Every state-table row has a test.
Tests are behavioural and would fail on broken code, except that AC-8 is untested after the deletion. I did not run them: the cloudflare:workers vitest setup is left to CI.
The README describes the views. Nothing stale.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, and the query is built from a fixed table. The empty-table fallback is correct. The only defect is the stray blank line.
Titles are HTML-escaped. The view value is allow-listed. The SQL has no user input. The traffic-check regex now allows '?' but still refuses whitespace and '#'.
The diff adds a plain server-rendered HTML list and nav. There is no UI framework, stylesheet or component file.
There are no UI flows to demonstrate beyond the server-rendered HTML, and the PR says no browser was available. Behaviour is covered by the fetch-level tests.
The claim 'Tests deleted: none' is false (the AC-8 test was removed in c93cd5d). The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is also doubtful. The title is under 72 characters.
